name: Google Ads MCP Server
description: Enables interaction with Google Ads through the Google Ads API using GCloud authentication. Supports GAQL query execution, performance data retrieval, account management, and resource discovery with pagination and multiple output formats.

rawRecord.description: Enables interaction with Google Ads through the Google Ads API using GCloud authentication. Supports GAQL query execution, performance data retrieval, account management, and resource discovery with pagination and multiple output formats.

GOOGLE_ADS_AUTH_TYPE.description: Authentication type for Google Ads API

GOOGLE_ADS_API_VERSION.description: API version override (default v19). Example: v21

GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID.description: 10‑digit Ads customer ID. If omitted, tools will list accessible accounts and ask you to pick one

GOOGLE_ADS_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Direct token override for dev/tests (bypasses ADC)

GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN.description: Developer token (required for Ads API calls)

GOOGLE_ADS_CREDENTIALS_PATH.description: Required for oauth and service_account modes - path to credentials file

GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID.description: Manager (MCC) account ID; only needed when acting on a child through an MCC
